name: Listening Post
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Listening Post turns 29 curated AI-vendor feeds into your Omarchy bar radar for model news, pricing changes, status incidents, and engineering posts. Open four keyboard-ready lanes to check item age, follow a link, refresh, or mark an item read. Same-week releases cluster and providers with matching local agent-usage filenames can rise first. Fixed HTTPS sources poll every 15 minutes. Article pages are not fetched or retained. No account, token, telemetry, custom host, or user-supplied feed URL.
